algorithm: Stratify by source T/A/V pattern and ordered label tuple.
Sort IDs within tuple and shuffle with Random(42), in fixed pattern/tuple order.
Select one per observed tuple; allocate remaining quota proportional to residual capacity by floor and largest remainder, lexical tuple tie-break.
No split, y_M, model output, readability, media duration/difficulty, or future outcome used; report split only after panel selection.
speaker_id_source: direct speaker_id from Text annotation JSON; no filename inference
